value.answer: Overrated, I'd say. It's well made, third-party tested, and most people find it tastes decent. But several ingredients are underdosed and some amounts are hidden in proprietary blends, a dietitian called it one of the most expensive all-in-one supplements out there, and I found no independent clinical evidence for its benefit claims. If you take blood thinners or blood pressure meds, check with a doctor or pharmacist first, since reishi and grape seed can interact with them.
